title: VIXEN codegen must derive and refresh the kernel provider pin
body: Configure started with the tracked provider/cache at 6075f4129 while the merged lane required 23f8eb553236df9908b1cc735fc4b38cc4a8e9e3; the documented queued configure failed on the stale pin, and recovery required an explicit full -DVIXEN_KERNEL_PROVIDER_REVISION=23f8eb553236df9908b1cc735fc4b38cc4a8e9e3 override plus reconfigure. The facade/tooling should discover the current lane pin and refresh the cache without manual revision injection.

title: Generated view headers need dependency-complete consumers
body: After the queued ui-regenerate updated EditorLayers.g.h with material fields, the existing unscanned test_panel_dock_documents target did not recompile and failed at runtime with missing generated members. Recovery required the queued cmake --build .tmp/build --clean-first --target test_panel_dock_documents, which rebuilt 685 objects. The facade/build graph should register generated-header dependencies for every consumer so a normal incremental build rebuilds the test and production readers without a clean-first workaround.

title: VIXEN needs a discoverable content codegen gate alias
body: The worker-standard queued bash tools/check-content-codegen.sh invocation failed with exit 127 because that Undertow script is absent from VIXEN. The supported VIXEN equivalent is tools/check-vixen-codegen.sh --no-queue --build-dir .tmp/build, which passed 40 check targets under the queue. The facade should expose or document one repository-neutral gate name so lanes do not guess the consumer-specific path.
